exampleEn: I can't make it to the party, but I'd love to take a rain check.
exampleKo: 나는 파티에 갈 수 없지만, 다음 기회를 위해 미루고 싶어.
gameExamples: I'm busy this weekend, so I'll have to take a rain check on our dinner plans.
She asked if I wanted to go hiking, but I need to take a rain check due to my schedule.
Let's take a rain check on our movie night and reschedule for next week.
